output.reason: New bladder control difficulty and perineal numbness a week after a lifting back injury are cardinal features of possible cauda equina syndrome, a surgical emergency needing immediate ED assessment with MRI today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression in the lower spine, which needs urgent scanning and possibly surgery — delay risks permanent damage. Have someone drive you or call 911 if you cannot get there quickly or develop leg weakness or inability to urinate.
